event_corrections.source: Frames 4505.30-4506.58 (corr/fr/g1/b046a.png): O spawns 4505.38, is held, I comes out and makes a TETRIS (flash 4505.70-4506.10); next spawn J at 4506.58. No piece spawns or locks between 4505.4 and 4506.5, so the three None locks at 4506.10 are phantoms (read during the clear flash). nextcount (corr/fr/g1/nc46.txt) shows no shift there either.

corr/fr/g1/b054d.png: the O at 4796.77 clears only its bottom row (one-row flash 4796.80, the O's top half stays); REN counter goes 8->9; score +1650 at 4796.83 = single 300 + 9x150 REN (a double would be 2250). The cleared row is a coloured player row, not garbage.

corr/fr/g1/b054ko.png: J spawns 4797.47 (NEXT shifts), hard-dropped into the column-3 garbage well and locks on the KO frame 4797.70 (score +12 hard-drop at 4797.70); two-row clear flash at 4797.77 over the top garbage rows; score +2400 at 4797.80 = double 900 + 10x150 REN (single would be 1800, triple 3000). Lock is at end_s, so it counts.

corr/fr/g1/b057ko.png: J spawns 4873.33 and is held, T comes out and locks vertically in column 8 at 4873.60 (lock streak, score +6 at 4873.60), before the KO 4873.63; no clear flash, no line cleared.

corr/fr/g1/b059.png: the T at ~4947.5 is a zero-line T-spin (T-SPIN banner, no row flash, board rows unchanged); score +300 at 4947.53 (a mini single would be 600, plus REN). The next clear (triple, +1500 at 4948.33) carries no REN bonus, so the previous lock cleared nothing. The 4947.57 event is the following O lock, which clears nothing.

corr/fr/g1/b066a.png, b066z.png: Z spawns 5237.37, is held, O comes out and fills the second row (a full player row, not garbage); one-row clear flash at 5237.53, REN counter 6->7; score +1350 at 5237.57 = single 300 + 7x150. This single breaks B2B, so the TSS at 5239.93 scored 2400 (+2400 at 5240.60), not B2B 3600, which is the -1200 the spot flagged.
